title: Minimum site area per grouped dwelling (Table 3B)
text: Minimum and average site area. C4.1.1 Development which complies with the dwelling type and site area provisions set out in Table 3B and the following provisions. Table 3B Site area requirements. Site area per dwelling (m2), Min: R2 5000; R2.5 4000; R5 2000; R10 875; R12.5 700; R15 580; R17.5 500; R20 350; R25 300; R30 260; R35 220; R40 180; R50 160; R60 120; R80 100; R100-SL 80. R80 site area provisions apply to all grouped dwellings located on lots coded R100, R160 and LR, MR and HR. - Indicated not applicable. Site area variations. Site area variations are subject to C4.1.1. C4.1.4 The following variations to the minimum and average site area set out in Table 3B may be made: i. in the case of a grouped dwelling; the area of a lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot approved by the WAPC; or ii. the area of any existing lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot with permanent legal access to a public road, notwithstanding that it is less than that required in Table 3B. C4.1.5 In areas coded R25 and below; for a small dwelling (in accordance with C2.9.1) that is the subject of a proposed development, the minimum and average site area of Table 3B may be reduced by up to 35 per cent. C4.1.6 In areas coded R30 to R40; for an accessible dwelling designed to gold level universal design (in accordance with C2.7.1), or a small dwelling (in accordance with C2.9.1) that is the subject of a development proposal, the minimum and average site area of Table 3B may be reduced by up to 35 per cent, provided that: i. for grouped dwellings, no site is less than 100m2; and ii. for development or subdivision of 4 or more dwellings or sites, the site area reduction is limited to a maximum 50 per cent of the total number of dwellings or sites. C4.1.7 In areas coded R50 and above; for an accessible dwelling designed to gold level universal design (in accordance with C2.7.1), or a small dwelling (in accordance with C2.9.1) that is the subject of a development proposal, the minimum and average site area of Table 3B may be reduced by up to 35 per cent, provided that: i. for grouped dwellings, no site is less than 100m2; and ii. the site area reduction is limited for small dwellings to a maximum 50 per cent of the total number of dwellings or sites.

exceptions.label: C4.1.4(i) area of a lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot approved by the WAPC
C4.1.4(ii) existing lot with permanent legal access to a public road
C4.1.5 small dwelling at R25 and below: minimum and average site area reduced by up to 35%
C4.1.6 gold-level accessible or small dwelling at R30 to R40: reduced by up to 35%, no site under 100 m2, at most 50% of 4 or more sites
C4.1.7 gold-level accessible or small dwelling at R50 and above: reduced by up to 35%, no site under 100 m2, small dwellings at most 50% of sites

verified.note: Table 3B minimum values (p54) and C4.1.4 to C4.1.7 (p53) checked. C4.1.7(ii) 'the site area reduction is limited for small dwellings to a maximum 50 per cent of the total number of dwellings or sites' (p53) does not say how it applies to a single dwelling or lot or to gold-level accessible dwellings; the C4.1.7 exception keeps verify true.

notes: diverges: Table 3B (p54) for Table 2B, and the tested fact is the site area per dwelling (subdivision.site_area_per_dwelling_m2, the smallest dwelling site calculated per C4.1.2(i): land occupied by the dwelling plus areas for its exclusive use, adjusted per C4.1.3) rather than site.area_m2. The 50% caps of C4.1.6(ii) and C4.1.7(ii) count dwellings: proposal.dwelling_count and the proposed fact proposal.reduced_site_area_dwelling_count. C4.1.4(i)/(ii) make the rule not applicable where the dwelling's own lot, survey-strata or strata lot is WAPC-approved or existing with legal road access; a new grouped development on a parent lot should answer false (verify). C4.1.5 to C4.1.7 concessions: tested area / 0.65 must reach Table 3B. Coding bands from helper tables table-4.1a/b/c. Average per dwelling is C4.1.1-r7; lots created by subdivision are C4.1.1-r1, -r4 to -r6.
